metadata.description: ShipWithAI — an AI-native delivery studio: a fleet of specialist agents running on a shared, legible context layer (its plugins, skills + conventions) to design, build, deploy, grow and monitor real products. Runs locally in Claude Code.

plugins.name: shipwithai-core
plugins.description: Shared studio coordinator (PM) and reusable skills for every delivery vertical.

plugins.name: shipwithai-audit
plugins.description: Smart-contract security audit vertical — Feynman / Nemesis / State-Inconsistency methodologies, run locally to produce a client audit report.

plugins.name: shipwithai-web
plugins.description: Web & e-commerce build vertical — Claude Design round-trip (code↔canvas via GitHub), frontend, backend, payments, deploy.

plugins.name: shipwithai-growth
plugins.description: Growth vertical — SEO optimization and marketing campaigns.

plugins.name: shipwithai-video
plugins.description: Marketing-video vertical — Remotion promo/explainer videos from captured deliverables + motion graphics.

plugins.name: shipwithai-monitor
plugins.description: Post-launch monitoring & alerting vertical — 24/7 watch of tech uptime, sales, traffic, SEO, security, and reputation, with scheduled check cycles, digests, and notifications.
